Nina (CSM): Quick sync  Perseus requests EU launch support next week. Needs: route traffic to eu-west, a temporary QPS increase for /v1/chat, and a header-based bypass for our bot-rate limiter. They indicated the launch outcome affects renewal.
Maya (CS): Window: 2024-08-14 09:00-12:00 UTC. Peak expected ~150 rps. Requesting ~3x QPS on chat and small bump for embeddings.
Sam (Eng-Infra): What's current QPS for them? Which CIDRs will they come from?
Nina (CSM): Current 60 QPS. They provided CIDRs: 52.14.200.0/24 and 3.120.64.0/18. Header: X-Partner-Live: perseus.
Tess (NetOps): I can add egress ACLs and geo-route to eu-west once NET ticket created. Need exact start/end and rollback contact.
ops-bot: Created NET-7044 and EDGE-11011.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Draft rate rule: match header + CIDR -> chat qps 180, embeddings 45, start/end times, auto-revert + alert at 85%. Will push to staging after NetOps green.
Leah (Billing): Please include billing_tag: perseus_aug14 so we can surface surge usage separately. We'll prep a one-off addendum for surge rates.
Maya (CS): Tests: Perseus to run curl with header 15 minutes before start. Also do a 50% canary load.
Tess (NetOps): NET-7044 updated with times and contacts (perseus-net@perseus.co). Monitoring hooks added.
Nina (CSM): Perseus sent confirmation and PO pending. Sales asked for the addendum template.
Sam (Eng-Infra): ETA to staging config after NetOps: 2.5 hours. I'll set a fallback to eu-central with lower QPS in case of capacity issues.
Maya (CS): Noted renewal risk. Sales to escalate if PO delayed.
Leah (Billing): Addendum draft ready, awaiting PO.
Nina (CSM): Thanks all  I'll post the preflight test results here.
ops-bot: EDGE-11011 status -> in-progress. NET-7044 -> in-progress.
